arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,b.request_id,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) holds,(select group_concat(c.charge_id) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b where status<>"confirmed"
select * from charges where booking_id in (select booking_id from bookings where status="pending")
select event_id,status,attempts,substr(payload,1,200) p from outbox where status<>"delivered" order by event_id
select service,status,message,count(*) n,max(id) last from request_logs where id>(select max(id)-60 from request_logs) group by 1,2,3

select (select count(*) from bookings where status="confirmed") conf,(select count(*) from checkins) ci,(select count(*) from charges) ch,(select group_concat(distinct state) from charges) st,(select count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from checkins c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) noci,(select count(*) from bookings b where (select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id)<>1) badch,(select count(*) from charges c where not exists(select 1 from bookings b where b.booking_id=c.booking_id)) orphan,(select group_concat(distinct status) from outbox) os,(select count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and (select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id)<>1) nohold

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,(select group_concat(c.state||":"||c.amount_cents||":"||c.idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b where (select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id)<>1
select id,service,path,status,message from request_logs where id>(select max(id)-45 from request_logs) and service in ("booking","payment","checkin","inventory") order by id
select id,service,path,status,message from request_logs where id>(select max(id)-45 from request_logs) and service in ("booking","payment","checkin","inventory") order by id
select * from customer_events where event_type<>"requested" limit 30
select * from customer_events order by rowid desc limit 8
